candidate_windows.window_text: When fine-tuning, $\mathrm{PEG}_{\mathrm{base}}$ was trained for 5 epochs with a batch size of 4 and a random seed set to 2022. To this end, we employed the Huggingface Trainer $^{13}$ using the default hyperparameter settings, with the exception of the Learning Rate values and the optimisation method. Instead, we used the Adafactor stochastic optimisation method (Shazeer and Stern, 2018) and a Learning Rate value of 3e-05. The training was performed on a single Tesla V100 GPU, while the testing was performed on a single Quadro RTX A5000 GPU. The checkpoint with minimum evaluation loss was employed for testing.
